# KwikTask

> KwikTask is a simple task board and task management system. Admins assign tasks and manage tasks; workers claim a task in one tap, do it, upload a screenshot as proof, get reviewed by a person, and withdraw their earnings to UPI.

## What makes KwikTask different
- Several emails, one login: one account can hold up to 10 verified emails; each email can take every task once; all earnings go to one wallet.
- Quick and simple: sign up with an email and a one-time code; every task shows its reward, slots left and time limit up front; works on any phone as an installable web app.
- Easy payment and cash withdrawal: approved work is credited straight away; workers withdraw by typing an amount and a UPI ID; every payment is recorded with its payment screenshot.
- Fair, explained reviews: every submission is reviewed by a person who pays 100%, 75%, 50%, 25% or 0% of the reward, always with a note.
- Built for sales tasks: tasks can carry sales scripts (shared out evenly among workers) or keywords to mention.
- Team roles: the owner decides who can create tasks, review work, make payments, manage users or handle support.

## Who it is for
Sales teams, field teams and freelancers who are paid per completed task, and the businesses that assign, review and pay for that work.
